text:
Kerapac — Hybrid Magic-Melee

​
Introduction
This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in #kerapac-hm-basic.
​
This method aims to consistently hit sub-1:40 kill times.
​
It is not required to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer assignment for this method to work, but it will improve your consistency with the Slayer helmet stand boost 
​
Gear, Relics and Familiars
⬥ Magic-Melee Hybrid 
​
Notes:
⬥ At the bank, activate/apply:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon poison +++ 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kwuarm sticks 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lantadyme sticks 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Darkness 
⬥ Perks on both Magic and Melee gear:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Genocidal  if on slayer assignment
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ultimatums 4 
⬥ Necklace:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Am-hej  for the Melee portion (unless using an )
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amulet of zealots  for the Magic portion alongside Mystic Might and Overcharge
